components: A measurable user or system invariant is defined first.
A realistic failure and tightly bounded blast radius are selected.
The fault is introduced while telemetry and abort signals are watched.
Fallback, isolation, and recovery behavior are observed.
Unexpected results become fixes and a repeatable regression experiment.
